title: Three Nights and One Short Score
subtitle: 音乐之声 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 音乐之声（文学艺术与体育·音乐与表演）
meta: 主题语境：音乐之声（文学艺术与体育·音乐与表演）　|　核心词汇：rhythm　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 rhythm 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1994 the musician ① kept the rhythm that no listener in the hall would have counted, and he said the keeping was the whole of the night. The ② rhythm, meaning the beat itself and not the score, ran three nights and stayed uncounted in the book; a rhythm, he said, is the only thing in a hall that is judged by how long it is left uncounted.

Every ③ rhythm in that hall had the same short score beside it, and the ④ rhythm at the far piano, meaning the note they kept for the children to play and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A rhythm, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to count; the musician said the counting is the part that fills three nights.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the rhythm was the whole of the matter, meaning the order and not the beat. The ⑥ rhythm, meaning the order and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody counts; rhythm, he said, is either something you keep or the only word that means both a beat and an order. He said the order is the part they remember.

By 1999 the ⑦ rhythm had become a line in a programme, and the programme had become an argument about the short score. The ⑧ rhythm of the whole thing, the musician wrote in December, was one hall and three nights of counting; rhythm, he said, is either the note at the far piano or the reason you learned to count. He said the counting was never mentioned.

The ⑨ rhythm I remember is the beat counted in the programme, which closed in 2001 and is still counted as the quietest in the hall. A ⑩ rhythm, my mother said in 2003, is the only beat that improves by being counted; every rhythm, she said, is an order that has agreed to look like a beat. She said the order was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 节奏；韵律（指音乐厅里每一种旁边的那一种）
B. n. 节奏；韵律（指那种节奏本身，与薄薄的乐谱相对）
C. 固定搭配：keep the rhythm 打这一种节奏
D. n. 节奏；韵律（指留给孩子们弹的那一个）
E. n. 节奏之事（抽象总称，指一处音乐厅的节奏之事）
F. n. 节奏；韵律（指节目单里写到、被清点的那一种）
G. n. 节奏、节律（指一件事里人人都听却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 节律（抽象总称，指人人都听却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: kept the rhythm that no listener in the hall would have counted
The rhythm, meaning the beat itself and not the score
the rhythm at the far piano
the rhythm was the whole of the matter
the rhythm had become a line in a programme
The rhythm of the whole thing
A rhythm, my mother said in 2003

answers.why: keep the rhythm 意为“打这一种节奏”，1994 年那位乐师把音乐厅里没有一位听客肯清点的一种节奏做了一遍。
rhythm 意为“节奏；韵律”，指那种节奏本身而不是薄薄的乐谱，它经过了三个夜晚而在簿子上没有被清点。
rhythm 意为“节奏；韵律”，指音乐厅里每一种旁边的那一种，每一种旁边都有同一份薄薄的乐谱。
rhythm 意为“节奏；韵律”，指最远那张琴凳的留给孩子们弹的那一个，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
rhythm 意为“节奏、节律”，指一件事里人人都听却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这种节律就是那件事的全部。
rhythm 意为“节律”，指人人都听却无人提起的那样东西而不是那种节奏，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
rhythm 意为“节奏；韵律”，指节目单里写到、被清点的那一种，到 1999 年这一种成了节目单里的一行。
rhythm 意为“节奏之事”，乐师十二月写道，整件事的节奏之事是一处音乐厅和三个夜晚的清点。
rhythm 意为“节奏；韵律”，我记得的是节目单里清点过的那一种，2001 年奏完了，至今仍被说成音乐厅里最安静的一种。
rhythm 为抽象总称，母亲 2003 年说，节奏是唯一会因为被好好清点而变得更好的节奏。
